_meta.source: X12 CARC list, curated subset of the highest-volume codes in US healthcare RCM
_meta.notes: Each entry includes the standard description, a denial family used by the evidence layer, the typical responsible party, and whether the denial is generally appealable. The 'family' field drives which deterministic extractor is invoked.

4.description: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used, or a required modifier is missing.
4.common_resolution: Verify and resubmit with the correct modifier (often 25, 26, 59, LT, RT, 50).

11.description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.
11.common_resolution: Repoint diagnosis pointers to a supportive secondary diagnosis or add a more specific ICD-10 code.

16.description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s) which is needed for adjudication.
16.common_resolution: Inspect accompanying RARC codes (e.g., N20, N350, N386) to identify the specific missing field, correct, and resubmit.

18.common_resolution: Confirm against historical claims; if legitimately a repeat service (e.g., bilateral procedure), resubmit with appropriate modifiers (LT/RT/50/59) and documentation.

22.description: This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits.
22.common_resolution: Identify primary payer and resubmit; if already submitted to primary, attach the primary EOB.

27.common_resolution: Bill the patient or verify eligibility on the date of service.

29.description: The time limit for filing has expired.
29.common_resolution: If a delay reason code applies (corrected claim, secondary, payer error), submit appeal with documentation; otherwise denial generally stands.

45.description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
45.common_resolution: Contractual write-off; verify fee schedule is current.

50.description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a 'medical necessity' by the payer.
50.common_resolution: Validate diagnosis-procedure compatibility; consider repointing to a supportive secondary diagnosis or appealing with clinical documentation.

96.common_resolution: Verify benefit; if patient signed an ABN, bill the patient.

97.description: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service that has already been adjudicated.
97.common_resolution: Bundling/NCCI edit. If services are clinically distinct, append modifier 59 or appropriate X-modifier with documentation.

109.description: Claim/service not covered by this payer/contractor. You must send the claim/service to the correct payer/contractor.
109.common_resolution: Identify correct payer (often a Medicare Advantage plan instead of FFS Medicare) and resubmit.

151.description: Payment adjusted because the payer deems the information submitted does not support this many/frequency of services.
151.common_resolution: Validate units and frequency limits; appeal with documentation if medically necessary.

167.common_resolution: Check LCD/NCD covered diagnoses; repoint or add a covered diagnosis if clinically applicable.

197.common_resolution: If prior auth was obtained, resubmit with the auth number; if not obtained, request a retro-authorization with clinical justification.

198.common_resolution: Request additional units or extension to existing authorization.

204.description: This service/equipment/drug is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.

252.description: An attachment/other documentation is required to adjudicate this claim/service.
252.common_resolution: Submit requested documentation (medical records, op note, lab results) per the accompanying RARC code.
